summary: Tested delete-confirm and empty-save features end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases passed (delete requires 'confirm=delete' case-insensitive, PUT rejects empty items with 400, hero/search regression OK). Frontend: all UI acceptance criteria verified via Playwright (dialog gating case-insensitive, cancel closes, delete succeeds, editor Save disabled when items empty, Save enabled after adding item, editor delete redirects to /orders/current).
critical_code_review_comments: OrderEditor.js is >1100 lines — consider splitting into sub-components (search panel, manual-add form, items table).
editor `markSent` and `reopen` still use window.confirm() rather than the new ConfirmDeleteDialog. Non-blocking, but stylistically inconsistent with the new destructive-action UX.
seed_data_creation: Test orders created and cleaned up during Playwright run; test data uses TEST_ prefix in remarks/part numbers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_delete_and_empty_save.py covers: DELETE requires ?confirm=delete (case-insensitive), PUT rejects empty items array, hero/search returns {'parts': [...]} shape. ConfirmDeleteDialog data-testids: <prefix>-overlay, -dialog, -input, -cancel-btn, -confirm-btn where prefix is 'orders-list-confirm-delete' (row) or 'editor-confirm-delete' (editor). Editor Save button has data-testid='editor-save-btn' and is disabled when items.length===0.
